---
name: test-gap-audit
description: Audit changed behavior for missing, weak, stale, or mis-scoped tests and produce a prioritized worklist.
---

# Test gap audit

Read the changed implementation, related tests, and documentation. Map each changed behavior to the tests that prove it. Identify meaningful gaps such as empty inputs, shape/dtype assumptions, boundary thresholds, malformed files, and regression paths. Rank gaps by impact and provide focused test cases. Do not edit code unless explicitly asked; do not recommend tests that merely restate constants or implementation details.
